fusions.name: Dabbled Muck
fusions.desc: Flicks a gob of wet mud that deals 4 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Pondbed Heave
fusions.desc: The ground around you turns to wet mud, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 60% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Water Off Stone
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it. You carry 8% physical resistance.

fusions.name: Stepping Stones

riders.text: you cross it faster than you cross ground
and you are harder to hit while you stand on it
and your health recovers faster while you stand on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.
